items.title: The team behind Tailwind CSS is joining Shopify

items.title: Fuzzing the State Machines Inside My HTTP Client
items.blurb: ffetch had a full suite of passing tests for retries, hedging, timeouts, and cancellation. Describing the rules instead of the cases, and letting fast-check generate network outcomes and timings, found eleven real defects.
